incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate from /v1/generate (500s) in us-west-2 — P99 latency spiked. Incident ID: INC-2026-0315-01 :rotating_light:
Alice Ops: seeing it too, spike started ~1771234500. Paging SRE oncall @Devon (SRE).
Devon (SRE): joining. triaging now — can someone paste a quick example of the failing request?
Alice Ops: sample from prod logs: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","prompt":"hello"}'` -> 500 with body `{"error":"kvcache miss: underlying executor OOM"}`
Jia (Runtime): that message looks like KV cache eviction cascade hitting the runtime worker. Are we seeing memory OOMs on the node pool?
Devon (SRE): checking node metrics... yes, several g4dn nodes in pool-embed-01 show GPU mem pressure and host OOM kill traces around 1771234488.
Marta (Eng Lead): is this the recent kvcache change from last week? we rolled a config that increases in-memory cache size by default.
Jia (Runtime): correct — config change `kvcache.default_size: 14GB` went live yesterday. it may be too aggressive for low-memory instance classes.
Sam (PM): customer impact: Priya, any escalations?
Priya (CSE): one active support case from AcmeCorp complaining about request failures since ~09:24 PST. they reported user-facing errors and rate-limited retries. they've paused production traffic for now.
Devon (SRE): immediate mitigation steps proposed: 1) revert kvcache.default_size to 8GB via rollout to runtime-1, 2) scale up pool-embed-01 by +2 nodes, 3) enable graceful fallback to rwd-3b for affected requests. Thoughts?
Jia (Runtime): rollback of config is fastest. I'll prepare a canary rollback to runtime-1 and runtime-2. fallback to rwd-3b needs API route change — we can enable model fallback policy at the load-balancer layer, 2-3 min deploy.
Alice Ops: Devon — can you run the scale up while Jia rolls back config? I'll coordinate with cloud.
Devon (SRE): scaling +2 nodes now (aws autoscaling override applied). ETA ~4m.
Jia (Runtime): applying rollback to runtime-1 canary: `kubectl -n runtime set env ds/kvcache CONFIG_SIZE=8G --record` — kicking now.
Devon (SRE): scale up succeeded at 1771234535. new nodes join, waiting for health checks.
Alice Ops: observing 500s dropping on some requests. Gradual decrease.
Priya (CSE): emailed AcmeCorp that we're investigating and applied mitigation; asked them to retry in 5m.
Marta (Eng Lead): once we confirm stability, we should schedule a postmortem. also need to decide whether to keep the reduced default or implement smarter eviction heuristics.
Devon (SRE): at 1771234560 error rate down to baseline. marking incident as mitigated. Will keep monitoring for 30m.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-2026-0315-01 status changed to Mitigated by Devon (SRE) — 1771234560
Alice Ops: handoff to next oncall in 30m. prep notes: root cause likely overly-large kvcache on small instance types leading to OOMs and downstream 500s; mitigation = rollback config + scale up + optional model fallback.
Jia (Runtime): logging snippet for postmortem: ```
[1771234486] runtime: kvcache insert key=abcd size=2.1GB -> memory pressure
[1771234488] kernel: oom_kill_process pid=4321 comm="executor" target="pytorch_worker"
[1771234490] runtime: executor crashed, returning 500 to client
```
Sam (PM): ok we need a postmortem doc, owners, and action items. propose: draft postmortem by this week, SOC review, rollback to 8GB until we have heuristics.
Marta (Eng Lead): owners: Jia (runtime) — technical writeup & mitigation plan, Devon (SRE) — timeline & monitoring improvements, Alice Ops — customer comms summary, Sam — product impact & decision on default size.
Priya (CSE): I'll follow up with AcmeCorp and ask for failure repros and whether retries succeeded after mitigations.
Devon (SRE): action items (short): [1] Add kvcache config guardrail: prevent default >10GB on instance types <16GB host RAM (owner: Jia) — due 2026-03-22. [2] Add OOM alert + auto-evict trigger to detect cascading evictions earlier (owner: Devon) — due 2026-03-18. [3] Implement model-fallback policy feature flag for API routes (owner: Marta) — due 2026-04-01. [4] Postmortem doc + timeline (owner: Jia & Devon) — due 2026-03-19.
Marta (Eng Lead): also propose a brown-bag 30m session on kvcache internals + prevention patterns next week — propose 2026-03-24 10:30am PT. will send calendar invite.
Sam (PM): add retros + runbook updates to the list: update runtime runbook with rollback steps and the guardrail checks (owner: Alice Ops) — due 2026-03-20.
incident-bot: NOTE: scheduled follow-up: postmortem doc requested — owners Jia, Devon; due 2026-03-19.
Alice Ops: switching to monitoring-only mode, handing off to next oncall @Zack (Ops) at 1771234605. I'll paste runbook fragment in the postmortem.
Devon (SRE): leaving a pointer to temporary dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abc123/kvcache-ooms?orgId=1 — includes GPU mem, host mem, error rate.
Priya (CSE): thanks all — I'll include AcmeCorp notes in the postmortem when available.
Marta (Eng Lead): thanks team — good quick mitigation. let's make the follow-ups concrete in the postmortem so we don't repeat.
Alice Ops: ended handoff at 1771234605 — leaving thread for postmortem discussion and the brown-bag scheduling. :white_check_mark:
